pages.text: $(li)Summoning creates ordinary living creatures.$(li)Command alters the behavior of existing creatures.$(li)Nature directs growth.$(li)Transmutation changes matter.$(li)Warding protects bodies and blocks.

$(li)Divination reveals what is hidden.$(li)Passage changes movement and traversal.$(li)Illusion conceals or creates temporary unreality.$(li)Necromancy manipulates undead states.$(li)Griefing destroys or destabilizes the world.
pages.title: The Remaining Schools
